assumptions: NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0's deltablast against the bundled SMART PSSMs.
limits: Searches the subjects given, not a public database.
bio.jane/contract.question: Which of these subject proteins resemble this one, by a profile built from its SMART domains?

description: DELTA-BLAST, run on this machine: build a position-specific profile for a protein from the SMART conserved domains it contains, then search other proteins with it (one PSI-BLAST iteration) — more sensitive than BLASTP for distant homologs. Searches the open record's coding sequences unless `subjects` gives FASTA. NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0's algorithms, checked against the deltablast program on every bundled protein. Nothing is sent anywhere.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

domain_inclusion_evalue.description: conserved-domain hits with E below this build the profile (`-domain_inclusion_ethresh`).

evalue.description: report alignments with E at most this (`-evalue`); BLAST's default is 10.

protein.description: the protein, one-letter codes; wire it from translate_sequence or read it off a CDS.

source.description: where the SMART database is read from: 'bundled' (a byte-identical copy of NCBI's file) or 'ncbi' (NCBI's FTP site, now). Advanced.

subjects.description: the proteins to search, as FASTA; leave empty to search the open record's coding sequences.

threshold.description: lowest profile word score seeded in the lookup table (`-threshold`). Advanced.

name: delta_blast_smart

domains.description: the conserved-domain alignments DELTA-BLAST built its profile from (rpsblast at the domain inclusion E-value): accession, shortName, title, and each HSP's query and model coordinates, score, bits, E-value, identities and aligned strings

profile.description: how the profile was built: domainsUsed, columnsCovered, meanObservations, and the profile's gapped lambda and kappa

proteins.description: every protein hit, best first: id, title, length, and each HSP with query and subject coordinates, score, bits, E-value, identities, positives, gaps and aligned strings
